scope: Week03 nine first-appearance current primary rasters in three successive groups; native meal-role layout correction and food/drink/Western coordinate inspection.
method: Every listed current raster opened full native size with view_image and compared with current Japanese objectives/bodies. Replacement PNG and encoded WebP also opened.

units.observed: Supervisor inspects employee hands; tied hair, uniform and clean shoes shown as detailed insets. No jewelry or decorative nails near food.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s3/s4: hair, hands, uniform/shoes and cleanliness need separate checks.

units.topic: Clean handling of plate and glass
units.observed: Employee holds plate outer rim without touching plated food; separate scene supports glass at lower portion/stem away from drinking rim.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s1/s2: safe touch zones and guest-relative service sides; exact side convention clarified by native guide, facility methods still apply.

units.topic: Three cooked dishes apart from rice/soup/pickles
units.observed: Original image had fish and only one separate vegetable side plus pickles, inconsistent with three-dish objective. Repaired image has fish, simmered pumpkin/carrot, dressed greens/mushrooms, plus rice, soup and separate pickles.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s1/s2: three dishes means meal-role count, not three vegetables; guest-side rice left and soup right.
units.decision: repair missing second side dish in raster and native layout

units.observed: Plate centered; fork left; knife and spoon right; bread plate upperleft; dessert utensils above. Knife eating edge faces plate. No halal/vegetarian suitability claimed by empty table.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s1/s2: guest-relative utensil placement; s3/s4 cultural food requirements must be confirmed separately.

units.observed: Front/chef/server compare a record before covered-plate service; ingredients visually separated from ready-to-eat vegetables. Scene is an information check, not a guarantee of allergen-free service or verified storage conditions.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s1/s2/s4: identify person, ingredient and dish through order/preparation/service; no unverified safety assurance.

units.observed: Employee wipes tabletop while colleague readies napkins/cutlery; supervisor checks list. No unverified concentration/time/temperature given.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s1/s2/s3: tables, equipment and kitchen/guest information need active verification, not assumed completion.

units.observed: Staff report by radio and indicate unattended case from distance; no opening/touching or use of unfamiliar equipment. Corridor cabinet is an example, not actual hotel exit map.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s02/s03: know own-site equipment/routes and report location/appearance without unsafe handling.

units.observed: Planning team examines business/leisure/dining examples with communication material. No claim all people in a segment have identical needs.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: segmentation/targeting/coordination: distinguish grouping and selection then share justified target/value.

units.topic: Supervisor listens to report and coaches
units.observed: Supervisor and two employees review report with notebook in staff setting. No unsupported unlock, disability assistance technique or emergency treatment depicted.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: coaching/investigate/improve: hear outcome/facts, investigate and share improvements; other operational cases stay in lesson text.
